title: Topic 16
japanese_text:
A：このクリアファイルの絵、きれいだね。
B：いいでしょ。上野の美術館で印象<u>派</u>展を見てきたんだ。そこで買ったの。
A：これは誰の絵？
B：ルノワールっていう画家の<u>風俗</u>画だよ。閉館<u>間際</u>に入っちゃって、ゆっくり鑑賞できなかったから、今度一緒に行こう。
english_translation: A: The image on this clear file folder is really pretty. B: Isn't it nice? I went to the Impressionist School exhibition at the Ueno Museum of Art. I bought it there. A: Who painted it? B: It's a painting by the artist Renoir depicting manners and customs. I went into the museum just before it closed, so I didn't have time to take a good look at it. Let's go see it together next time.
